title: Elemental Shaman in Forever
summary: Elemental is Shaman's ranged spellcasting spec, dealing damage with Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Flame Shock and Lava Burst, backed by fire totems.

strengths: Forever's baseline cast-time cut to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning
Lava Burst hits harder when Flame Shock is already on the target
Chain Lightning hits every target for close to single-target Lightning Bolt damage
Searing Totem for one target and Magma Totem for several add steady damage
weaknesses: Slower leveling than Enhancement, because its damage depends on cast times
Hard casts leave it idle while moving
Raid build spends points in Restoration to reach spell hit
raid: Brings: Party totems alongside its own damage; no raid-wide buff or debuff

key.name: Elemental Fury
key.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

key.name: Lightning Overload
key.text: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

key.name: Lava Burst
key.text: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 114 to 145 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

key.name: Elemental Warding
key.text: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 10%.

key.name: Elemental Focus
key.text: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

key.name: Elemental Alacrity
key.text: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.

priority.name: Lava Burst
priority.clause: On cooldown while your Flame Shock is on the target

priority.name: Mana Spring Totem
priority.clause: Restores 10 mana every 2 seconds for its five-minute life

priority.name: Flame Shock
priority.clause: Keep Flame Shock on the target

priority.name: Lightning Bolt
priority.clause: The rest of the single-target rotation
